newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea unveils its first domestic F-16 fighter.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea unveils its first domestic F-16 fighter.

text.p: South Korea on Monday unveiled its first domestically produced F-16 fighter jet, which soared through the sky in a five-minute test flight.

South Korea -- which has bought nearly 50 U.S.-designed F-16 fighters -- has contracted Samsung Aerospace Industries Co Ltd to produce a total of 72 F-16s by 1999 under a U.S. licence, according to an Air Force official.
The Air Force said in a statement the fighters would help give South Korea superior air power in the event of a war with North Korea.
The two Koreas are still technically at war after the 1950-53 conflict ended in a truce, not a treaty.
Monday's test flight follows the opening of an air base to operate F-16s launched recently by President Kim Young-sam at Sosan, about 100 km (60 miles) southwest of Seoul.
